routines.semantics: raw.azlrec(range,az,el,azccw,elplsz) returns an owned rectangular Vec3. azccw=true measures azimuth from +X toward +Y; false reverses its direction. elplsz=true measures elevation toward +Z; false toward -Z. Angles are radians; range and result share distance units. Finite negative range and unwrapped angles pass unchanged to CSPICE. No kernels or scientific-error conditions are required for ordinary finite inputs.

Compare negative range, positive/negative angles beyond one turn, and elevation outside the customary interval without imposing normalization.
Compare zero range, both elevation poles and the positive X axis; retain actual trigonometric residuals.
Compare every component at ranges 1e200 and 1e-200; focused live rescaling makes tiny nonzero outputs observable.

routines.semantics: raw.pgrrec(body,lon,lat,alt,re,f) returns an owned Vec3 for planetographic coordinates on the specified spheroid. Body names/numeric ID strings pass unchanged to CSPICE; JS/native boundaries reject embedded NUL. re>0 and f<1 are required; negative f and altitude are permitted. Angles are radians and remain unwrapped; alt,re and result use the same units. Current character BODY<ID>_PGR_POSITIVE_LON EAST/WEST overrides select longitude sense; otherwise nonnegative PM rate gives west-positive and negative rate east-positive. Earth defaults east without PM. Moon/Sun default east only after successful PM lookup in pinned N0067. Finite-input nonfinite results remain observable.

scenarios.observes: Compare actual outputs for EARTH, numeric ID 399, and a mixed-case/space-padded body name without client-side rewriting or a PM fixture.
Load authored positive/negative PM rates, compare both synthetic names and their numeric IDs, and observe the third body with an EAST override but no PM.
Load explicit positive PM coefficients for Sun and Moon, then observe their east-positive exception instead of the ordinary west-positive nonnegative-rate rule.
Compare all outputs for f=0, f=0.2 and negative f=-0.25, distinguishing a permitted prolate spheroid from an invalid flattening.
Compare complete results at 1e100 and 1e-100 physical scale. Focused live assertions rescale distance quantities while retaining unscaled angular comparisons.
Observe the same body through default west-positive, a space/case-tolerant EAST override, WEST override, and clear/reload restoration on the same workflow.
Observe Earth default east, WEST override and restored east after kclear, without a PM dependency.
Pass an unrecognized body name and observe IDCODENOTFOUND from CSPICE.
Use an unconfigured numeric body ID and observe MISSINGDATA.
Use Moon without PM/override and observe MISSINGDATA, distinguishing the pinned lookup prerequisite from an unconditional east-positive shortcut.
Install character NORTH as longitude sense and observe INVALIDOPTION.

Pass f=1 and observe VALUEOUTOFRANGE instead of a zero polar radius calculation.
Compare below-surface altitude, negative/unwrapped longitude, latitude beyond pi/2 and a pole without invented angle/altitude rejection.

routines.semantics: raw.srfrec(body,lon,lat) returns an owned point on the triaxial ellipsoid from the current numeric BODY<ID>_RADII pool variable. body is a signed 32-bit integer; exactly three positive radii are required. Longitude always increases from +X toward +Y and latitude is planetocentric, measured from the XY plane along the ray from the origin. Angles are radians and unrestricted. The result uses radii units. No PM/planetographic convention is applied; actual missing/malformed pool-data errors propagate.
